text: The Corporations Nominating Panel will select candidates to be interviewed for appointment to the CreateTO Board. The Nominating Panel will conduct interviews at its next meeting and recommend one candidate to City Council for appointment.

The Corporations Nominating Panel: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview for appointment to the CreateTO Board: Candidate TRB2-351 Candidate TRB2-373 Candidate TRB2-391 Candidate TRB2-413 Candidate TRB2-425 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1a, 1b, and 2 to the report (November 22, 2024) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the CreateTO Board.
